Investigate this suspected problem.

Suspect S1: Existing callers of calculate_total missing new discount argument
Category: correctness
Location: app/pricing.py lines 12-12 (new version)
Suspected problem: The calculate_total function signature was changed to require a third parameter (discount), but existing callers across the repository may still be calling it with only two arguments, causing TypeError at runtime.
What would confirm or refute it: Search the repository for all calls to calculate_total to verify whether they have been updated to pass the new discount argument.

The planner's summary of the pull request: Adds a required discount parameter to calculate_total in pricing and updates tests accordingly.

Budget: 6 turns (each reply is one turn), up to 3 tool calls per turn. Finish with submit_verdict.
